name: Hankuk Paper MFG. Co. Ltd.
summary: Hankuk Paper MFG. Co., Ltd. focuses on the production and distribution of diverse paper products. Their offerings span categories such as industrial-grade, food-contact, functional, decorative, and transfer papers. The company's operations are organized into its Printing Paper and Cardboard business divisions. It was established on July 16, 1984, and its main office is located in Ulsan, South Korea.
